thornberry.name: Thornberry
notes: A thornberry bush, heavy with dark red fruit. The thorns draw a bead of blood as you pick.
More thornberries, bitter-sweet. Something has been eating them, and recently.

mistlantern.name: Mist Lantern
notes: A mist lantern: an old iron lamp on a post, still lit, though nobody tends it.
Another mist lantern. The flame bends toward the drowned chapel.

lore.way: the deer track that climbs out of The Mirewood into the dry green of The Thornwood

sign.mirewood: Hunters come down from The Thornwood with fresh kills and stranger stories every week.
sign.thornwood: Below the wood the ground turns soft: The Mirewood begins where the thorns end.

lore.way: the woodcutters' road from the gates of Hearthmere into The Thornwood

sign.hearthmere: The woodcutters will not go far into The Thornwood any more: something follows them home.
sign.thornwood: Smoke from the chimneys of Hearthmere rises above the trees, a day's walk off.

lore.way: the cold path where The Thornwood thins into the iced reeds of The Frostfen

sign.thornwood: Frost from The Frostfen has crept into the north of the wood: the thorns are white at dawn.
sign.frostfen: Beasts from The Thornwood come down to the ice to drink, and do not all go back.

lore.way: the green road inland from The Cinder Coast to The Thornwood

sign.cinder_coast: Inland, the green of The Thornwood looks like another world after the ash.
sign.thornwood: Ash from The Cinder Coast drifts through the canopy and greys the thorns.

lore.way: the drowned causeway where The Mirewood sinks into The Mistmoor

sign.mirewood: The fog that rolls in from The Mistmoor smells of old candles and wet stone.
sign.mistmoor: Behind you the bog of The Mirewood is almost cheerful by comparison.

lore.way: the funeral road from The Mistmoor up to the mounds of The Barrow

sign.mistmoor: The dead of the drowned chapel were carried to The Barrow once. Some are walking back.
sign.barrow: Mist from The Mistmoor coils round the mounds, and the gravelights flicker in it.

lore.way: the old church road from Hearthmere down into The Mistmoor

sign.hearthmere: Nobody in Hearthmere takes the church road since the chapel in The Mistmoor drowned.
sign.mistmoor: Up the old church road, the lamps of Hearthmere are warm and far away.

lore.way: the boundary ditch between The Thornwood and The Mistmoor

sign.thornwood: South of the ditch the wood gives way to The Mistmoor, and the birds stop singing.
sign.mistmoor: Across the ditch The Thornwood stands green and thick, and the mist will not cross it.
